sentences.ko: 파자르가 전선에 걸려 넘어지면서 휴대폰이 책상 밑으로 날아갔어요.

sentences.text: Saat rapat daring, Lestari merasa seperti terlempar dari obrolan karena sinyalnya putus-putus.
sentences.en: During the online meeting, Lestari felt like she'd been thrown out of the conversation because her signal kept cutting out.
sentences.ko: 온라인 회의 때 신호가 자꾸 끊겨서 레스타리는 대화에서 튕겨 나간 기분이었어요.

sentences.text: Setelah pukul sembilan, para karyawan mulai berdatangan ke kantor.
sentences.en: After nine o'clock, the employees start arriving at the office.
sentences.ko: 아홉 시가 넘으면 직원들이 하나둘 회사에 도착해요.

sentences.text: Setelah aplikasi itu viral, tawaran kerja sama mulai berdatangan ke kotak masuk Lestari.
sentences.en: After the app went viral, partnership offers started pouring into Lestari's inbox.
sentences.ko: 앱이 입소문을 타자 협업 제안이 레스타리 메일함에 몰려들기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: Petugas kebersihan yang berseragam hijau membersihkan ruang kerja Fajar setiap sore.
sentences.en: The cleaning staff in green uniforms clean Fajar's workspace every afternoon.
sentences.ko: 초록 제복을 입은 청소 직원들이 매일 오후 파자르의 사무 공간을 청소해요.

sentences.text: Lestari tidak mewajibkan karyawannya berseragam karena ingin suasana kantor santai.
sentences.en: Lestari doesn't require her employees to wear uniforms because she wants a relaxed office atmosphere.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 편한 분위기를 원해서 직원들에게 제복을 입으라고 하지 않아요.

sentences.text: Kursi di meja Fajar berkaki lima dan bisa berputar ke segala arah.
sentences.en: The chair at Fajar's desk has five legs and can swivel in all directions.
sentences.ko: 파자르 책상 의자는 다리가 다섯 개라 사방으로 돌아가요.

sentences.text: Maskot aplikasi Lestari adalah kucing berkaki pendek yang lucu.
sentences.en: The mascot of Lestari's app is a cute short-legged cat.
sentences.ko: 레스타리 앱의 마스코트는 다리가 짧은 귀여운 고양이예요.

sentences.text: Fajar berpikir alangkah enaknya kalau kantor punya ruang tidur siang.
sentences.en: Fajar thought how nice it would be if the office had a nap room.
sentences.ko: 파자르는 회사에 낮잠 방이 있으면 얼마나 좋을까 생각했어요.

sentences.text: Lestari membayangkan alangkah bangganya ibunya kalau melihat aplikasi itu dipakai banyak orang.
sentences.en: Lestari imagined how proud her mother would be to see so many people using the app.
sentences.ko: 레스타리는 많은 사람이 앱을 쓰는 걸 엄마가 보면 얼마나 자랑스러워할지 상상했어요.

sentences.text: Alarm kebakaran kantor tiba-tiba meraung saat latihan evakuasi.
sentences.en: The office fire alarm suddenly wailed during the evacuation drill.
sentences.ko: 대피 훈련 중에 회사 화재경보기가 갑자기 울부짖듯 울렸어요.

sentences.text: Di luar jendela kantor Lestari, sirene ambulans meraung di tengah kemacetan.
sentences.en: Outside Lestari's office window, an ambulance siren wailed in the middle of the traffic jam.
sentences.ko: 레스타리 사무실 창밖에서 구급차 사이렌이 꽉 막힌 길 한가운데서 울려 댔어요.
